source: For this example, the solution set contains two disjoint intervals.
aiReference: Dalam contoh ini, himpunan penyelesaian terdiri atas dua interval yang saling lepas.

source: Let A = ∅ and B = ℝ. Their union equals B.
aiReference: Misalkan A = ∅ dan B = ℝ. Gabungan keduanya sama dengan B.

source: If |x| < 3, then x lies in (−3, 3).
aiReference: Jika |x| < 3, maka x berada dalam (−3, 3).

source: Record the identifier sample-alpha~run-7~trial-2 exactly.
aiReference: Catat identifier sample-alpha~run-7~trial-2 secara persis.

source: Himpunan penyelesaian tidak mencakup kedua titik batas.
aiReference: The solution set does not include either boundary point.

source: Untuk setiap n ∈ ℕ, berlaku n ≥ 0 menurut konvensi yang digunakan di sini.
aiReference: For every n ∈ ℕ, n ≥ 0 holds under the convention used here.

source: Gabungan kedua interval ditulis sebagai (−5, −2) ∪ (4, 8).
aiReference: The union of the two intervals is written as (−5, −2) ∪ (4, 8).

source: Pernyataan ini merupakan asumsi, bukan kesimpulan dari data.
aiReference: This statement is an assumption, not a conclusion from the data.

source: Group C included 12 participants, whereas group D included 18 participants.
aiReference: Kelompok C mencakup 12 peserta, sedangkan kelompok D mencakup 18 peserta.

source: The confidence interval includes zero; the estimated effect is therefore uncertain.
aiReference: Interval kepercayaan mencakup nol; karena itu, efek yang diestimasi masih belum pasti.

source: The median is reported because the distribution is asymmetric.
aiReference: Median dilaporkan karena distribusinya tidak simetris.

source: The table reports observations rather than causal effects.
aiReference: Tabel tersebut melaporkan pengamatan, bukan efek kausal.

source: Kelompok C memiliki 14 pengamatan dan kelompok D memiliki 21 pengamatan.
aiReference: Group C has 14 observations and group D has 21 observations.

source: Simpangan baku menggambarkan sebaran data, bukan ketidakpastian rata-rata sampel.
aiReference: The standard deviation describes the dispersion of the data, not the uncertainty of the sample mean.

source: Model ini mungkin menjelaskan sebagian variasi, tetapi tidak membuktikan hubungan sebab akibat.
aiReference: This model may explain some of the variation, but it does not prove causation.

source: Parameter diestimasi dari data pelatihan dan dievaluasi pada data terpisah.
aiReference: The parameters were estimated from training data and evaluated on separate data.

source: The reagent concentration was 7 μM and the incubation time was 15 min.
aiReference: Konsentrasi reagen adalah 7 μM dan waktu inkubasi adalah 15 min.

source: The Ca2+ signal did not increase after treatment.
aiReference: Sinyal Ca2+ tidak meningkat setelah perlakuan.

source: This small experiment cannot establish clinical effectiveness.
aiReference: Eksperimen kecil ini tidak dapat membuktikan efektivitas klinis.

source: A solution containing sodium chloride was prepared before the assay.
aiReference: Larutan yang mengandung natrium klorida disiapkan sebelum pengujian.

source: Larutan mengandung 8 nM reagen dan disimpan pada 4 °C.
aiReference: The solution contains 8 nM reagent and is stored at 4 °C.

source: Konsentrasi Ca2+ diukur sebelum dan sesudah perlakuan.
aiReference: The Ca2+ concentration was measured before and after treatment.

source: Tidak ada bukti yang cukup untuk menyatakan bahwa terapi ini aman bagi semua pasien.
aiReference: There is insufficient evidence to state that this therapy is safe for all patients.

source: Hasil awal menunjukkan kemungkinan manfaat, tetapi penelitian lanjutan masih diperlukan.
aiReference: The preliminary results suggest possible benefit, but further research is still needed.

source: Rainfall increased at station P but decreased at station Q.
aiReference: Curah hujan meningkat di stasiun P tetapi menurun di stasiun Q.

source: The model predicts a possible change, not a certain outcome.
aiReference: Model memprediksi kemungkinan perubahan, bukan hasil yang pasti.

source: Measurements were collected at 6 m and 9 m above ground.
aiReference: Pengukuran dilakukan pada ketinggian 6 m dan 9 m di atas tanah.

source: The dataset identifier climate-observations~site-P~2026 must remain unchanged.
aiReference: Identifier dataset climate-observations~site-P~2026 harus tetap tidak berubah.

source: Suhu rata-rata meningkat di lokasi P dan menurun di lokasi Q.
aiReference: The average temperature increased at site P and decreased at site Q.

source: Hubungan yang diamati tidak selalu menunjukkan mekanisme sebab akibat.
aiReference: The observed association does not necessarily indicate a causal mechanism.

source: Sensor ditempatkan pada kedalaman 3 m selama 24 h.
aiReference: The sensor was placed at a depth of 3 m for 24 h.

source: Ketidakpastian pengukuran harus dilaporkan bersama estimasi.
aiReference: Measurement uncertainty must be reported alongside the estimate.
